verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is a local video-production app that orchestrates Claude Code or Codex as its backend. It is not itself a general coding agent, so exposing an official MCP server for outside agents is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows an MCP server, an `mcp serve` mode, or a hosted MCP endpoint. The CLI commands and the 'adding another AI' extension point cover the agents ReelMimic uses internally, not an MCP server that other agents connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
